prompt_base: Rich painterly atmospheric fantasy meditation illustration, portrait 2:3. Midnight navy, violet, delicate stars, layered mountains, reflective water. Subject lower right, dark uncluttered left for text. No lettering, UI, icons, people, borders or watermark.

scenes.sunset: Glowing golden sun over a winding mountain river valley, layered navy mountains and pines.

fallback: Shared category illustrations for other meditations; the original catalogue is unchanged.
